Items that can no longer be obtained. HIDDEN BY DEFAULT in the roadmap - Tate: 'We dont care about limited items at all.'

IMPORTANT: the client does NOT encode this. There is no LIMITED / RETIRED / UNOBTAINABLE token in any of the 4,240 items' <Labels>, and Ceremonial Wand even carries ORG_LIBRARY as though it still drops in the Cursed Library. So this list is CURATED, not derived, and it is the one file here that needs a human. Add an id, save, re-run build.ps1.

Seasonal items are deliberately NOT listed: Easter, Halloween and Oryxmas gear comes back.

Feed.evidence: equip.xml: <Object type="0x5e1f" id="Feed"> carries <Description>Ultimate Feed Power.</Description>, <PetFood /> and <feedPower>50000</feedPower> - twice the next-highest food in the game. It has no name beyond "Feed", no drop source in any of the 246 files, and no source resolver in this project matches it.

Stat Test Helm1.evidence: equip.xml: <Object type="0x44a1" id="Stat Test Helm1"> with <DisplayId>Helm of minstack</DisplayId>. The id says what it is; it carries the ST label with no set, no source in any of the 246 files, and a BagType of 8 which is what slips it past the AdminOnly/no-BagType filter.
